mapper.select: select a.`resource_id` as resourceId, a.`blue_green_id` as blueGreenId, b.`name` as blueGreenName, b.`sort` as blueGreenSort from `deploy_job_resource_blue_green` a join `deploy_blue_green` b on a.`blue_green_id` = b.`id` where a.`job_id` = #{value}
mapper.insert: insert into `deploy_app_instance_blue_green` (`app_system_id`, `app_module_id`, `env_id`, `resource_id`, `blue_green_id`) values (#{appSystemId}, #{appModuleId}, #{envId}, #{resourceId}, #{blueGreenId}) on duplicate key update `blue_green_id` = #{blueGreenId}
